overview.headline: Functions link variables uniquely with trig ratios fixed by angle

keyPoints.point: A function means one variable depends uniquely on another variable in a problem
keyPoints.quote: the value of one variable in a problem depends uniquely on the value of another variable in the problem.

keyPoints.point: An exponential function relates a variable to times it is used as a multiplier
keyPoints.quote: The exponential function relates a variable to the number of times another variable is used as a multiplier

keyPoints.point: Sine cosine and tangent relate sides and angles of a triangle
keyPoints.quote: The trigonometric functions sine, cosine, and tangent relate the various sides and angles of a triangle.

keyPoints.point: Dividing scaled sides gives same value as black triangle showing ratio fixed
keyPoints.quote: Dividing out the “2’s” gives x divided by y, the same value as the black triangle.

keyTerms.gloss: uniquely determined link where value depends on another variable
keyTerms.quote: An important mathematical concept is the idea of function – the value of one variable in a problem depends uniquely

keyTerms.gloss: repeated multiplier use where variable counts times as multiplier
keyTerms.quote: The exponential function relates a variable to the number of times another variable is used as a multiplier

keyTerms.gloss: inverse operation that counts times variable must multiply itself
keyTerms.quote: The logarithmic function is the inverse of the exponential; it gives the number of times that you must multiply a variable by itself

keyTerms.gloss: adjacent side divided by hypotenuse for fixed angle value
keyTerms.quote: For the black triangle, the cosine of “b” is equal to x divided by y.
